train_vae_model: train a VAE model using JAX Haiku with Adam optimizer and ELBO loss
run_vae_training_loop: run the VAE training loop with configurable iterations learning rate and checkpointing
create_vae_loss_function: create a JIT-compiled loss function that computes negative mean ELBO for VAE training
build_vae_update_step: build a JIT-compiled gradient update step using JAX grad and Optax Adam optimizer
test_vae_elbo_metrics: test VAE model by computing ELBO data fidelity and KL divergence metrics
